title: Funds sent onward to third parties the account holder does not transact with
definition: Credits received from one party and debited onward to unrelated third parties, without the account holder appearing to have a commercial relationship with the recipients. The indicator measures the absence of a stated relationship; it does not establish that the funds were held for others.
evidence_to_cite: the inbound and outbound transaction records
any statement of the account holder's role in the movement of the funds
the customer due diligence file and the declared purpose of the account
benign_explanations: A market stall holder who receives cash from traders and pays suppliers.
A concierge or a payment service that passes funds to end customers.
A customer who manages money for relatives and is candid about it.
A business holding funds briefly before a refund, with the refunds visible in the same account.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, guidance on third-party payment processing, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
